clean_body: News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong. | | | | | | Letter from the Chair Fellow Republicans, With the recent release of Anthony Fauci's work journals and his repeated, self-serving invocation of the Fifth Amendment during congressional testimony, the concerns raised by skeptics throughout the COVID era have been thoroughly vindicated. Fauci oversaw funding for gain-of-function research at the Wuhan lab and helped obscure the lab-leak origin of the virus that upended the world. Meanwhile, physicians who dared question the official narrative were publicly vilified; many lost their licenses, livelihoods, and reputations. As a scientist trained to believe that genuine science thrives on rigorous questioning, I watched in dismay as dissent was crushed under the mantra "trust the science"--while Fauci himself declared, "I am the science." Critics were smeared as "flat-earthers" and worse for refusing to accept the approved storyline. Natural immunity was systematically downplayed, and promising alternative treatments were condemned so that mRNA vaccine manufacturers could secure Emergency Use Authorization--and, later, broad legal immunity from lawsuits. Here in Nebraska, a handful of leaders stood firm against the tide of fear-driven policy and defended both public health and individual liberty. Voters should remember who those leaders were--especially current U.S. Senator Pete Ricketts, NE-02 nominee Brinker Harding, and Omaha City Council members Aimee Melton and Don Rowe. As governor, Pete Ricketts guided Nebraska's response with data-driven focus: preserving hospital capacity, deploying targeted Directed Health Measures, protecting essential services and local businesses, and never imposing a full statewide stay-at-home order or broad mask and vaccine mandates. He prioritized voluntary compliance and local flexibility over top-down decrees. A POLITICO analysis published April 22, 2022, put it plainly: Ricketts "never ordered a statewide shutdown when 43 other governors, Democrats and Republicans, did so; he has stood against, or even supported lawsuits over, local mask requirements; he has told state agencies not to comply with federal vaccine mandates and gotten scolded by the U.S. secretary of defense for objecting to such requirements for the National Guard. And yet by the fall of last year, when POLITICO crunched the data of state pandemic responses on a combination of health, economic, social and educational factors, one state came out with the best average: Nebraska." One of the lawsuits Ricketts supported listed Omaha City Council members Brinker Harding, Aimee Melton, and Don Rowe as plaintiffs. In August 2020, the Omaha City Council passed an emergency indoor face-covering ordinance 7-0. Harding and Melton opposed mandates in principle. Recognizing they lacked the votes to defeat a stricter version, they worked to amend the measure, making it more limited. A pure "no" vote would have left a harsher ordinance intact. Harding, Melton, and Rowe therefore supported the narrower version that ultimately expired in May 2021--while Harding publicly criticized the rushed process. These leaders stood in the breach and chose principle and practicality over panic. Nebraska voters should remember that record and their moral courage. Together, We Win! Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces. In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud. In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson. In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others. In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime. Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? **Peter, what is a lobbyist?**

According to the dictionary, a lobbyist is _a person paid to try to influence lawmakers and public officials to pass or change laws in a certain way._

You know what else lobbyists often are? **Former members of Congress.**

Over the past 15 years, more than **350 former members of Congress** have become lobbyists. In one recent year alone, **more than half** of departing members walked straight into lobbying jobs. _That's the revolving door._

They get elected. They build relationships. They do favors for powerful interests. Then, when they're done serving in Congress, those same interests reward them with lucrative lobbying jobs where they can use their connections to influence the people who replaced them. Meanwhile, the people who sent them to Washington are left wondering why nothing ever seems to change.

Christina's had enough.

She believes members of Congress should go to Washington to serve the people who elected them, not spend years auditioning for their next job. **That's why she'll fight to ban current and former members of Congress from becoming lobbyists and help restore trust in a government that too many Americans feel has stopped working for them.**

The Washington Post is calling our race “highly competitive,” and I need your immediate grassroots support to keep the momentum.
Peter, look at this:
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260807-partner-sb.S8B76e&amount=5&refcode=em20260807-938&t=2&akid=938%2E34582%2EMC0sL5)
Ohio is the most competitive race in the country – and analysts agree. The Republican dark money machine sees it too, and they’re funneling a whopping $133 million to drown us out before Ohio voters even get a say.
[**Please, will you split $5 between me and Small Town PAC?**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260807-partner-sb.S8B76e&amount=5&refcode=em20260807-938&t=3&akid=938%2E34582%2EMC0sL5)
The political ground in Ohio is shifting, and voters are taking a harder look at the direction things are headed. That means the seat Husted was appointed to – never elected to – is winnable.
That’s why this race is already on track to be one of the most expensive Senate races in history – if we don’t win Ohio, we can’t flip the Senate blue. With the latest poll from _The New York Times_ showing me within striking distance of Husted, the avalanche of Republican money could be enough to bury our momentum for good if we don’t respond right now.
I can’t win this race alone. [**Please, will you split $5 or more now to help me and Small Town PAC fight back, flip this seat, and keep Ohio in play?**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260807-partner-sb.S8B76e&amount=5&refcode=em20260807-938&t=4&akid=938%2E34582%2EMC0sL5)
Thank you.
-Sherrod

| | | | |
---
SpaceX's IPO made history. The stock hit $165 in a week.

But the most important part of this story may not be the rockets.

It's Starlink. T-Mobile just enabled Starlink satellite connectivity on every iPhone and billions of phones are coming online for the first time.

Starlink sells them the connection. That's where its job ends. But every hour those people spend on their phones generates ad revenue - and someone has to collect it.

I found the company doing it. 490 million users. A billion dollars earned and saved. 32,481% revenue growth - enough to make it the #1 software company according to Deloitte's fastest growing companies list in 2023. $11.8 million in EBITDA in 2025. And it hasn't gone public yet.

Series A open at $0.52/share.

But on August 14, the opportunity to invest at this price closes — and it's gone after that.

Every previous round sold out. I don't expect this one to last either.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

#

❗ Friends — to everybody who cares about our fight for gun safety, please don’t skip this important message.
Lauren Boebert just introduced legislation that would overturn the USPS’s ban on mailing handguns that’s been in place since 1927. We need you to help fight back.

For nearly 100 years, federal law has prohibited the United States Postal Service from carrying or delivering handguns as mail — with exceptions for members of the military, law enforcement, or licensed gun manufacturers or dealers.
Lauren Boebert and Donald Trump are trying to change that.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260807-1-b&t=1&akid=11706%2E3935704%2EPqelTr)
Donald Trump’s DOJ recently issued a memorandum saying they would no longer enforce this ban. Now, Boebert is trying to pass a bill that would officially let the USPS deliver guns through the mail — with no background checks, licensing, or training.

If this goes into effect, it would mean people who shouldn’t have a gun will be able to go around state and federal laws and get a gun mailed to them.
**This change also means that gun traffickers have a new way to move firearms through America’s communities.**
At a time when gun violence is the #1 killer of kids and teenagers in our country, this rule would make us all less safe. We need to fight back.

You have helped us so much to fight back against extremist legislation and pass gun safety laws. Now, we need your support again to fight back against Lauren Boebert and the gun lobby’s plans.

clean_body: ❗ Friends — to everybody who cares about our fight for gun safety, please don’t skip this important message. Lauren Boebert just introduced legislation that would overturn the USPS’s ban on mailing handguns that’s been in place since 1927. We need you to help fight back. For nearly 100 years, federal law has prohibited the United States Postal Service from carrying or delivering handguns as mail — with exceptions for members of the military, law enforcement, or licensed gun manufacturers or dealers. Lauren Boebert and Donald Trump are trying to change that. Donald Trump’s DOJ recently issued a memorandum saying they would no longer enforce this ban. Now, Boebert is trying to pass a bill that would officially let the USPS deliver guns through the mail — with no background checks, licensing, or training. If this goes into effect, it would mean people who shouldn’t have a gun will be able to go around state and federal laws and get a gun mailed to them. This change also means that gun traffickers have a new way to move firearms through America’s communities. At a time when gun violence is the #1 killer of kids and teenagers in our country, this rule would make us all less safe. We need to fight back. You have helped us so much to fight back against extremist legislation and pass gun safety laws. Now, we need your support again to fight back against Lauren Boebert and the gun lobby’s plans. As an instructor in Georgia State’s nursing school, I’ve spent years teaching and supporting the students who keep our healthcare system alive. I know how hard they work, how much they sacrifice, and how urgently our state needs more advanced practice nurses — not fewer.
So when I saw this headline...
https://secure.ngpvan.com/4OI02pK92kOTd_uWTjBgFg2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4OI02pK92kOTd_uWTjBgFg2]

Under Donald Trump’s new proposal, advanced nursing degrees would no longer count as “professional,” meaning students would lose access to the federal loans they need to pursue graduate education. Loan limits would be slashed in half. Thousands of future nurse practitioners, nurse midwives, CRNAs, and clinical nurse specialists could be forced to take on massive private debt — or give up their dreams entirely.
This is not just bad policy.
It’s dangerous — for patients, for hospitals, and for the future of healthcare in this country.
Georgia already faces provider shortages. Rural communities already wait weeks for care. And now Trump wants to create even fewer advanced practice nurses?
We cannot allow this to go unanswered.
The American Nurses Association has already sounded the alarm, and more than 200,000 nurses and patients have raised their voices. Now I’m asking you to add yours:
Will you sign the petition demanding the Department of Education reverse this reckless decision and recognize advanced nursing degrees as the professional degrees they are? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4OI02pK92kOTd_uWTjBgFg2]

body:
A comment on the results of the Fifth District Democratic Primary.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/5da12152734a/why-me-17293398?e=bd44204496)

[|

## It Was Never About Me, It's About Our Democracy
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

[](https://us.list-manage.com/jKL5nkh3PKS?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)

The results are in for the Fifth District Democratic primary for Congress, and—well, I didn’t make it.
Former Congressman Tom Perriello just had too great an advantage in name recognition and his history in the district that his challengers couldn’t overcome.
I have promised to support Tom in the general election, and I will do so in any way I can. I’ve been saying all along that the people of the Fifth District need someone who will stand up for their rights and interests in Washington, DC, and someone who is not just a rubber stamp for Trump, and I am certain that Tom Perriello will be far, far, far more responsive to the will of the voters than our incumbent, John McGuire.
We get daily reminders of why we need this sort of thing. The latest is the approval, by the Senate, of Todd Blanche as Attorney General. This is the guy mainly responsible for burying the Epstein Files and for hatching a scheme to pay off violent January 6 rioters and give Donald Trump’s family permanent blanket immunity from the IRS. Blanche is outrageously corrupt, but the Republican Party will never, ever, ever stand up to Donald Trump.
This also highlights the diminishment of Congress and its complete subordination into a rubber stamp for the president. It is a reminder why we need to pay attention to the issue I put at the forefront of my campaign: the constitutional balance of power and the need to restore our system of checks and balances, so all power cannot be concentrated in one person.
My campaign was never about me or my personal vanity. It was about elevating that central issue and getting people to pay attention to it. As I return to [my job as a writer and commentator](https://us.list-manage.com/_L5GUfANSjx?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)—fortunately, running for office is not the only way I have of influencing our country’s future—I will continue to advocate for the bold actions and serious reforms we need to save our democracy.
I want to send out my thanks to the people who supported me, the volunteers, and the donors, and particularly my wife, who made me promise many year ago that I would never run for office—but who understood why I was running now and supported it.
The best part of campaigning has been traveling around the Fifth District and meeting a lot of terrific people who are engaged in making their communities better—and that includes the local news reporters who are continuing to do their important work under difficult circumstances. Politics on the national level, and the politics you see on cable TV and social media, tends to be mean and nasty and ugly, but it looks a lot better one-on-one, meeting people at the local level. And that’s something that gives me a little more hope that our democracy might survive this current moment.
Thank you for listening, thank you for listening to all of the things I’ve posted in this campaign, and thank you for your support.
See this [on video](https://us.list-manage.com/jnn0Vf4y4mS?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a).

Former Congressman Tom Perriello just had too great an advantage in name recognition and his history in the district that his challengers couldn’t overcome. I have promised to support Tom in the general election, and I will do so in any way I can. I’ve been saying all along that the people of the Fifth District need someone who will stand up for their rights and interests in Washington, DC, and someone who is not just a rubber stamp for Trump, and I am certain that Tom Perriello will be far, far, far more responsive to the will of the voters than our incumbent, John McGuire. We get daily reminders of why we need this sort of thing. The latest is the approval, by the Senate, of Todd Blanche as Attorney General. This is the guy mainly responsible for burying the Epstein Files and for hatching a scheme to pay off violent January 6 rioters and give Donald Trump’s family permanent blanket immunity from the IRS. Blanche is outrageously corrupt, but the Republican Party will never, ever, ever stand up to Donald Trump. This also highlights the diminishment of Congress and its complete subordination into a rubber stamp for the president. It is a reminder why we need to pay attention to the issue I put at the forefront of my campaign: the constitutional balance of power and the need to restore our system of checks and balances, so all power cannot be concentrated in one person. My campaign was never about me or my personal vanity. It was about elevating that central issue and getting people to pay attention to it. As I return to —fortunately, running for office is not the only way I have of influencing our country’s future—I will continue to advocate for the bold actions and serious reforms we need to save our democracy. I want to send out my thanks to the people who supported me, the volunteers, and the donors, and particularly my wife, who made me promise many year ago that I would never run for office—but who understood why I was running now and supported it. The best part of campaigning has been traveling around the Fifth District and meeting a lot of terrific people who are engaged in making their communities better—and that includes the local news reporters who are continuing to do their important work under difficult circumstances. Politics on the national level, and the politics you see on cable TV and social media, tends to be mean and nasty and ugly, but it looks a lot better one-on-one, meeting people at the local level. And that’s something that gives me a little more hope that our democracy might survive this current moment. Thank you for listening, thank you for listening to all of the things I’ve posted in this campaign, and thank you for your support. Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
NYT: Trump Leans on Congress to Address His False Claims of Voter Fraud [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=080726_1&amount=25]
President Trump has been trying everything his advisors can think of -- including blocking a bipartisan housing relief bill -- to press Congress to advance stalled legislation that purports to address his often-repeated -- and equally debunked -- claims of widespread election fraud. There are stats from the conservative, right-wing Heritage Foundation below that prove it.
The SAVE America Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE AMERICA ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=080726_1&amount=35]
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point. The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
Team, the consequences of a bill like this passing would be catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE AMERICA Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=080726_1&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

How do we know non-citizen voting is a made up problem? Because red states and conservative-leaning institutions have spent millions in taxpayer money and donor dollars searching for it and finding minimal results.
For example: The pro-Trump Heritage Foundation -- an organization that has funded anti-voting initiatives for decades -- maintains a database of "election crimes." Their own records only list 24 instances of non-citizens voting in U.S. elections from 2003 to 2023 . In other words -- 20 years of elections, millions of votes, and only 24 alleged non-citizen voters.
Reuters has a fuller accounting in recent reporting. Florida, for example, spent millions investigating voter fraud and creating a new state department to oversee election security. They've only prosecuted two non-citizens for voting since 2022. North Carolina said they found nine non-citizens registered to vote out of 7.7 million voters. Utah recently investigated their entire voter roll of 2.1 million registered voters and found one registered non-citizen who never attempted to vote.
The conservative CATO Institute says it best: " These investigations affirm what is simply common sense. People largely aren’t willing to risk their status in the United States — the land of economic opportunity — for the ability to cast one more vote out of hundreds of thousands or millions in a state and hundreds of millions in the country. "
Team, the lies aren't going to stop, but we can push back and make sure bills like this abomination never pass. Pitch in $35 or however much you can to stand against voter suppression bills in Congress and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=080726_1&amount=35]

It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

Friend, early voting kicks off in just a few weeks. Campaign season is now officially in full force!
We’ve built an incredible team. We’ve rallied. We’ve trained hundreds of volunteers. Now it’s GO TIME!
It’s time to reach every voter in the Commonwealth before early voting kicks off in just a few weeks on September 18.
This is our biggest push yet because we know every conversation, every volunteer shift, and every dollar invested now will help put us on the path to a historic victory in November.
Will you RUSH a contribution of $10 or more today to help us execute our game plan?
YES, COUNT ME IN! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vaforrepro-em?refcode=080726]
Your contribution will help us put more trained volunteers into the field, print more campaign materials, and educate more voters that voting YES on 1 = a vote for the freedom to make your own decisions about your reproductive healthcare, including abortion, birth control, and fertility care.
We’re determined to leave no stone unturned in the critical weeks ahead.
From busy suburban neighborhoods to small rural communities, we’re working to ensure Virginians in all corners of the Commonwealth understand why they should vote YES on 1.
Let’s not leave anything to chance. Please chip in one urgent contribution today! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vaforrepro-em?refcode=080726]
Thank you for believing in what’s possible and for helping fuel our powerful movement across Virginia.
In gratitude,
Hannah Servedio
Organizing Director
P.S. Victory for reproductive freedom in Virginia is within reach! We’ve come too far to let off the brakes now. Please make a contribution today to help us expand our movement at this pivotal moment in our history-making campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vaforrepro-em?refcode=080726]
Visit our website [https://va4reprofreedom.org/]
Virginians for Reproductive Freedom
600 Pennsylvania Ave SE Unit 15845
Washington, DC 20003

Peter,

**There's nothing wrong with being White.**

The anti-White and anti-Christian energy in America right now isn't even logical. When they're done silencing or persecuting all the White "conservatives", they'll just go after the White men on their own side. The ones who won't wear a dress or a leash first, then whenever or whoever else is convenient!

We, all of us, We The People need Whites to be just as proud of their heritage and culture as everyone else, or America doesn't survive.

Europe is the proving grounds right now, and they're failing the test. My great-grandmother was Norwegian; she married a Black man, end of story. Stop letting them guilt and gaslight you...

Their political platform is not based in reality. That's the bottom line, every time they bring up racism, it's a cover story. **Racism exists, but stupidity is much more prevalent.**

Meet Royce White:

**Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Living in various neighborhoods growing up, much of his family remained in the Rondo community, where he spent much of his time and received schooling. White excelled at basketball and recieved a scholarship to play basketball at the University of Minnesota, and later transferred to Iowa State. He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards.

_After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA’s collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. This resulted in White demanding that the NBA, as a representative of the global corporate community, take up the responsibility of spearheading the mental health conversation – not just posturing through press statements, but through policy._

Royce then went on to win two championships in Canada before moving over to play Big 3 Basketball. White appeared at a game in a t-shirt that read “Free The Uyghurs.” After a game-winning basket, White did a post-game interview on CBS, where he called for 2 Million Uyghurs to be freed and released from concentration camps. As the season went on, White would touch on taboo topics such as Gain of Function Research, The Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Larry Hoover, Jeff Fort, Muammar Gaddafi, The Great Reset, Ivermectin, Me Too, etc.

Now, Royce White is running for Senate in Minnesota to take down the Radical Left. Republicans have not seen recent success in Minnesota, but Royce's campaign is different: a grassroots movement that's sick of the Radical Agenda pushed by Far Left Democrats Tina Smith and Ilhan Omar. Royce needs your help to pull off a fourth quarter comeback victory and FLIP Minnesota Red for Republicans.

We just launched our Campaign Opportunities section on your [volunteer dashboard](https://home.forwardparty.com/your_dashboard?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_august&n=3). Let us know what skills you have, and connect directly with a campaign to volunteer. Click the button below to check it out! | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/candidate_support_signup?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_august&n=4 "Support a candidate!") [Support a candidate!](https://home.forwardparty.com/candidate_support_signup?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_august&n=4)
---
**_Builders Movement:_**
This fall we are partnering with our friends at the Builders Movement, a civic nonprofit with a community of 5M+ Americans, to encourage people to fire up their grill and strike up a conversation with someone different from you in an effort to bridge the divide in this country.
**What it is**
Builders Movement is asking Americans to host community gatherings across differences this summer, timed to America's 250th anniversary. The ask is simple: invite someone you do not always agree with, sit down together, and start there.
**The goal**
250 gatherings across all 50 states.
**How to participate**
Register at **[BuildersBBQ.org](BuildersBBQ.org). **The first 250 host receives a free Builders Starter Kit with recipes, conversation starters, Builders Jenga, and goodies from our brand partners.
**If you cannot host**
Share the campaign with your community using #BiteToUnite. Even one post or mention can inspire someone in your network to host.
**Why it matters**
Because connection across difference does not happen on its own. Someone has to fire up the grill first!
**_Volunteer Spotlight:_**
Our volunteer of the month for August is **Chris Stevens** in NC! She has been an effective, organized leader in the efforts to gather signatures for ballot access, and has remained dedicated, even after having surgery! This is what she has to say about volunteering with Forward, "...because experience has taught me that positive change rarely happens without effort. Our election system is broken and so, therefore, is our country. The only way to fix the situation as far as I can tell is for regular people to step up and take action." She's right about that. We appreciate everything you do, Chris!
**_Upcoming Events:_**
**Mon Aug 10th @ 7:30pm ET** \- [National Volunteer Call](https://home.forwardparty.com/national_volunteer_call_20260810?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_august&n=5)
* Your first stop to updates on the National party and how to plug into the work.

**Tues Aug 11th @ 7:30pm ET-** [Forward to the Polls](https://home.forwardparty.com/forward_to_the_polls_national_poll_worker_recruitment_day?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_august&n=6)
* Join us on National Poll Worker Recruitment Day to hear from others who have served and learn how to get involved.

**Mon Aug 17th @ 7pm ET** \- [Welcome Team Training](https://home.forwardparty.com/welcome_team_intro_call_20260817?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_august&n=7)
* Learn how to call and have friendly conversations with other FWD supporters in your state.

**Mon Aug 24th @ 7:30pm ET** \- [How to talk about Forward](https://home.forwardparty.com/recruitment_training_june_20260824?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_august&n=8)
* Tips and tricks on how to discuss Forward with people in your life.

**Wed Aug 26th @ 7:30pm ET** \- [Girls Just Want to Volunteer! ](https://home.forwardparty.com/wc_girls_just_want_to_volunteer?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_august&n=9)
* Special guests Lt Gov Healey and Gov Whitman inspire us to support candidates this fall!

You can find more things to do on our events [calendar.](https://home.forwardparty.com/public_calendar?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_august&n=10)
There was a lot to share with you this newsletter, thank you if you read this far. Next month I will resume bi-weekly communication to keep you informed on all our grassroots candidate support activities. Until then I hope to see you at an upcoming event, enjoy the rest of your summer!
With gratitude,
Carrie Anne

body:
By donating to the DLCC, you can help give state Democrats the resources they need to compete and win in the districts they call home. | | |
---
| |
---|---
The DLCC set a goal to invest $50 million in state legislative races this cycle. This number isn’t random. We determined this number based on the needs of our Target Map and the cost to compete in places like Pennsylvania, where Democrats hold an ultra-narrow majority in the state House. It costs an average of**$800,000 to run for a seat in the Pennsylvania House. In our most competitive districts, we could see this number skyrocket.** To fully fund our efforts in the _42 chambers and 27 states_ on our Target Map, we need consistent funding from grassroots supporters. By donating to the DLCC, you can help give state Democrats the resources they need to compete and win in the districts they call home. name: Troy Jackson
subject: I’m a fifth-generation logger
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY RESIST RECLAIM REBUILD PAC (WWW
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jackson [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jackson]
Growing up in Allagash and spending years working 80-hour weeks in the woods to make ends meet, I know firsthand what working Mainers need from our government.
And for 30 years, Susan Collins has failed us. Time and again, she has sold us out to Donald Trump and his MAGA agenda while pretending we’re too dumb to notice. And I’m sick of it.
My name is Troy Jackson. I’m a proud Mainer, father, and fifth-generation logger.
This weekend, I officially earned the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate. Now it’s time to defeat Susan Collins and her billionaire backers. So I’m asking you to split a donation between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild to become a Founding Donor to my campaign right now and help us win the most important Senate race in the country. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jackson]
DONATE TO DEFEAT SUSAN COLLINS AND FLIP THE SENATE! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jackson]
Let me tell you a bit about what this race means to me.
When I was growing up, I was a poor kid in a town full of poor kids. My family relied on food assistance at times. I distinctly remember when I was 13 years old, we didn’t have heat or running water, and I heard my mother quietly crying to herself, wishing she could do more for us.
After high school, I became a logger like my dad, and his dad, and his dad before him. When a greedy landowner tried to screw my fellow loggers and me out of fair wages, I fought back. A whole bunch of politicians, including then-first-term Senator Susan Collins, promised to listen, but they left us high and dry — and I realized that nothing would change unless there were working-class voices in power.
So I ran for the Maine legislature, where I served 20 years, including six years as the President of the Maine Senate. It’s been the honor of my life to fight for working people.
I drove hours each way between the North Woods and the State Capitol, because that's what the job required. I won those elections in a district that went for Trump by 20 points, because up here, people care less about a label and more about whether you give a damn about their family.
I’m building this campaign the right way. With grassroots support from folks like you. I’m not running to impress the billionaires or the corporate class. I’m running for the mom who’s worried about how she’ll fill her gas tank this week. I’m running for the kid whose whole life will be determined by the quality of his education. I’m running to ensure every working family in Maine has the government they deserve.
If you believe in this fight and our movement, I’m humbly asking you to split a donation between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild today to help us reach our fundraising goal and take on the GOP’s millions. Even $10, $25, or $50 makes a difference >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jackson]

In solidarity with you always,
Troy Jackson

**Friday, August 7, 2026 -**_** ** Explosions heard near Qeshm. Iran deal on Hormuz with Oman nears. Iran parliament speaker Mohammed Baghar Ghalibaf slams U.S. President Donald Trump's "theater diplomacy." Tehran sent Gulf countries list of power plants that it could strike if U.S. attacked its infrastructure, report says. Trump says Iran war "going very well," to end "pretty soon." Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian discusses effects of war, leadership of country. Mossad fires two senior officials over Iran war failure. White House tells Emiratis to silence Iran war critic. Number of Palestinian children held in Israeli prisons without charge sharply rises. Lebanese soldier wounded, water station set ablaze in Israeli attacks on southern Lebanon. U.S. says Hezbollah did not violate ceasefire in Majdal Zoun. Trump issues new executive orders targeting birthright citizenship. U.S. economy shed 23,000 jobs in July. Trump says he'll keep Todd Blanche as acting attorney general if Senate confirmation fails. ICE will release body camera footage only when in "agency's best interests." Democratic National Committee autopsy author says Gaza war hurt Kamala Harris in 2024. University of Minnesota to pay pro-Palestine professor after nixing job offer. Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan sign defense deal. U.S. intelligence claims Russia could test NATO with limited attack. Bombing near Damascus wounds 14. Former Mexican governor arrested for evidence destruction in missing students case. Uganda's parliament approves potential military deployment to Gaza. Attack on former Bangladesh cricketer Shakib Al Hasan's home follows his appearance alongside exiled Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announces new sanctions on Cuba. Iraqi resistance leader urges pause to operations against Saudi Arabia. Pro-Palestine protester acquitted in UK court._
**This is Drop Site Daily, our free news recap We send it Monday - Friday**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZHJvcHNpdGVuZXdzLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.2Q04xbNBujjWdtGqeINMkJZjZG49qbobUTj5G-cVmO4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=210232831)
* * *
# Iran
* **Explosions heard near Qeshm:** Two explosions were [heard](https://substack.com/redirect/a7055f67-c98e-496f-9493-c41ff799c572?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Qeshm Island on Thursday, Iran's Tasnim News Agency reported, and were reportedly caused by Iranian forces engaging with "hostile enemy targets" near the entry to the Strait of Hormuz.
* **Iran deal on Hormuz with Oman nears:** Hassan Ghashghavi, a spokesperson for the National Security Commission and an MP, said on Friday that a "framework of understanding" with Oman regarding the Strait had been agreed upon. "The general framework of the understanding with Oman has been determined, and the final text and details will be announced soon," Ghashghavi told the official IRNA news agency, noting that the "final decision" would be made at "higher levels."
* A senior Iranian official told Drop Site's Jeremy Scahill that Iran and Oman have finalized technical talks and agreed on temporary rules for the "security, supervisory, and economic management" of the Strait of Hormuz, following several rounds of negotiations.
* The official said Iran's implementation of the agreement remains conditional on the "full and tangible return" of the United States to the temporary ceasefire understanding, stressing that merely suspending the naval blockade would not be sufficient.

* **Iran parliament speaker slams Trump 's "theater diplomacy": **Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad and lead negotiator Mohamed Bagher Ghalibaf criticized President Donald Trump's repeated shifts between threatening a major attack on Iran and announcing negotiations, calling it "theater diplomacy on loop."
* Ghalibaf said, in a [post](https://substack.com/redirect/e2c395a9-2f4d-4975-9b3c-f9cd995787c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on X, that using "bullying + broken promises + fake news as leverage" was a failed strategy and urged Washington to "acknowledge the facts and fulfill your commitments," adding: "We don't need more theater."
* **Tehran sent Gulf countries list of power plants that it could strike if U.S. attacked its infrastructure, report says:** Iran [sent](https://substack.com/redirect/23d3bbf6-5f9a-4d21-868a-c318aea0469c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Gulf mediators a detailed list of power plants and desalination facilities it could strike if the U.S. attacked Iranian energy infrastructure earlier this week, the AFP reported on Thursday, threatening to "black out the Gulf, country by country" in response to Washington's potential attacks. Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the UAE subsequently urged Trump not to launch the planned strikes, according to the agency.
* **Trump says Iran war "going very well," to end "pretty soon": **In a post on Truth Social on Thursday, Trump claimed that the war on Iran was going "very well," adding that the country was "decimated." He also said he was "extremely happy" with War Secretary Pete Hegseth, who he reportedly confronted during a Cabinet meeting last week about low munitions supplies. "Everything has been extraordinary."
* While taking questions in the Oval Office from reporters, U.S. President Donald Trump said that the war on Iran would end "pretty soon," speculating that the Iranian government could not "go much longer."
* Trump also [asserted](https://substack.com/redirect/6613f469-71be-44b5-bebe-2ebfdfa8ef86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the Strait of Hormuz remained "sort of open" right now, despite acknowledging the previous day that Iran maintained its ability to threaten shipping through the waterway with its naval power.

* **Pezeshkian discusses effects of war, leadership of country:** Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said in an interview with Iran's IRNA news service that attacks on the country's power infrastructure caused "a daily shortage of approximately 230 million cubic metres of gas," and that the U.S. exerted "maximum pressure" on Iran, "expecting the country to collapse."
* He also [discussed](https://substack.com/redirect/5a7ab59a-b439-4b91-aa0a-e2de7f6b0900?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) his relationship with Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, saying that communication with Khamenei, who has not appeared publicly since his appointment in March, is currently "very difficult," but calling him a "major asset" in allowing Iran to continue its successful defense of the country.

* **Mossad fires two senior officials over Iran war failure:** Israel's Mossad chief, Roman Gofman, fired two of the spy agency's top officials over a failed plan to topple Iran's government, Israel's Channel 12 and Haaretz reported on Thursday.
* One of the officials had served as the head of Mossad's intelligence directorate since September, and the other was the head of the agency's Iran division.
* The two drafted the written plan to remove Iran's leadership by mobilizing the country's minority groups to rebel and whip up mass protests to oust the government.
* **White House tells Emiratis to silence Iran war critic:** The White House has reportedly [told](https://substack.com/redirect/48ba0be9-82dc-4fb8-8d57-26e0b3bfde45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the government of the United Arab Emirates to "shut down" Amjad Taha, a political strategist and journalist with ties to the government and a staunch advocate of Israel and the Abraham Accords, whose criticism of the U.S.'s war in Iran has "irked" Trump and his allies, according to a report from the Washington Times on Thursday.
* **Traffic through Hormuz drops sharply:** Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz dropped to 33 vessels between Monday and Thursday, down from 50 the previous week, according to data published by the maritime tracking firm Kpler on Friday.
* Citing data from ship-tracking company Kpler, Reuters said that only four vessels transited the strait on Thursday, including the very large crude carrier Nissos Kea, which was carrying about two million barrels of crude oil from Iraq.
* Several Chinese and Indian refiners have unsuccessfully sought vessels this week to enter the Strait and load crude at Iraq's Basrah Oil Terminal, following steep discounts offered by Iraq's state oil marketer.

# Yemen
* **Ansarallah clashes with Saudi-backed government in Marib and Hadramout:** Saudi-backed Yemeni forces reported that Ansarallah missile and drone attacks on the Yemeni provinces of Marib and Hadramout on Thursday killed at least 18 of its soldiers, with other reports putting the death toll as high as 58.
* The health minister of the Saudi-backed government later announced that a second round of attacks on Friday had killed two civilians and wounded 14 others.
* An Ansarallah political bureau member described Thursday's operations as a "preemptive" response to alleged plans by Saudi forces to attack Sana'a. Ansarallah's Supreme Political Council claimed Saudi Arabia had been preparing a ground invasion to create internal chaos and prevent an end to the country's "12-year siege," according to Tasnim.
* The Saudi-backed government said that its army had shot down multiple Ansarallah drones launched towards Marib on Friday, with several explosions reported.
* In the southwestern Saudi city of Najran, the Saudi-led coalition said projectiles launched by Ansarallah wounded 11 civilians, seven of whom were Saudi nationals and one of whom was a 4-year-old child.

* **Traffic increases through Bab Al-Mandab:** 26 vessels transited the Bab Al-Mandab Strait on Thursday, up from 19 the previous day, according to Kpler data.

# Palestine
* **UNICEF reports one Palestinian child killed every day in Gaza since "ceasefire": **"At least 300 children have been killed in Gaza in the 300 days since a 'ceasefire' went into effect on October 10, 2025, UNICEF said in a [statement](https://substack.com/redirect/12fcc21b-0ca4-4fec-84d1-e67d7b315b86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Thursday. "A ceasefire that leaves an average of one child dead each and every day is failing children," UNICEF's Regional Director for the Middle East and North Africa, Edouard Beigbeder, said. "With hundreds more children injured, many severely, children in Gaza are still waiting for the end to the violence they were promised."

* **Israeli forces withdraw from Qalandia as attacks continue across occupied West Bank:**
* **Qalandia:** Israeli forces [withdrew](https://substack.com/redirect/d951ab20-50ad-4d71-81e2-69d6719da6f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Qalandia refugee camp and Kafr Aqab in Jerusalem late Thursday after a two-day military raid that left 51 Palestinians injured and more than 60 detained or subjected to field interrogation, including women and children, according to the Jerusalem Governorate. Israeli troops also demolished seven shops and a car wash, damaged dozens of homes and businesses, and converted homes into military posts. Families also reported money and gold jewelry stolen during raids.
* **Jenin:** Israeli forces [shot and wounded](https://substack.com/redirect/6fe6e5ae-52f5-4560-b02c-92ded8347959?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) two Palestinians in Jenin on Thursday, including a 14-year-old, who soldiers shot in the lower back, according to WAFA. The Israeli military [closed](https://substack.com/redirect/9f493d8c-3136-4517-b14f-fa2cf2b4bdca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) off a roundabout, detained a group of young Palestinian men, and raided multiple shops. The military also [issued](https://substack.com/redirect/9c421344-a086-4207-8433-1053724b5468?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a series of new orders targeting land in several towns in Jenin on Thursday, including orders to uproot trees and seize more land in the town of Marka.
* **Ramallah:** Israeli settlers [attacked](https://substack.com/redirect/7ee06a22-ccf4-4eca-8602-ee002e5e98fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a Bedouin community near the town of Taybeh on Thursday, injuring three people from a single family, one international activist, and arresting a Palestinian, WAFA reported. In another attack on Thursday evening, Israeli forces [beat](https://substack.com/redirect/640c5ddd-69df-4852-a53f-320e197d2b01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and fired stun grenades at an 80-year-old Palestinian-American man near Turmus Ayya. He sustained cuts and bruises from the attack.
* Sen. Chris Van Hollen [demanded](https://substack.com/redirect/c0062ff5-c288-45f0-925c-d8c3a8b9f9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Thursday that U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee resign, pointing to the attack, following reporting from Zeteo that the man who was attacked is an American citizen.
* **Tubas:** Israeli forces [stormed](https://substack.com/redirect/7296d4f0-bde9-4c14-a69c-9dab782d6c3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the city of Tamman, near Tubas, early Friday morning, raiding the town and ransacking a house, according to WAFA. On Thursday, Israeli forces [released](https://substack.com/redirect/60513554-36b3-453b-9627-89cc9f698977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the body of a 28-year-old Palestinian who had been shot in Tubas in April, and whose body had been withheld from his family since.
* **Drop Site 's Mohamed Awad **interviewed residents from Tuba in Masafer Yatta, who were attacked by Israeli settlers on Wednesday. "They smashed and burned everything," one resident said, describing the attack that wounded five Palestinians, including a child whose nose was broken, and burned at least four homes.. "They left nothing untouched." **Watch Mohamed 's video dispatches [here](https://substack.com/redirect/ba5698ee-244f-4e11-8f48-bf47704db1f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [here](https://substack.com/redirect/4b36f3d5-512b-4292-90c8-1177ef898fbc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**

* **Hamas urges mediators to prevent Israel from derailing Gaza agreement:** Hamas called on mediators and the U.S. administration on Thursday, asking them to intervene to prevent Israel from derailing the Gaza agreement, saying continued Israeli violations threaten implementation of its second phase.
* The movement said Palestinian factions have engaged "positively and responsibly" with efforts to complete the agreement and presented their position on the roadmap "in a national spirit" that clears the way for implementing Phase 2.

* **Number of Palestinian children held in Israeli prisons without charge sharply rises:** At least**** 191 Palestinian children are being [held](https://substack.com/redirect/58b30888-8780-406c-80fc-417a39ff7abb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in "administrative detention" in Israeli prisons in March 2026, according to data from the organization Parents Against Child Detention, up from 103 in January of 2025, the Times of Israel reported on Friday..
* Palestinians in administrative detention can be held indefinitely and without trial, are not informed of the allegations against them, and evidence presented against them in court is routinely classified and withheld from the accused and their attorneys.

# Lebanon
* **Lebanese soldier wounded, water station set ablaze in Israeli attacks on southern Lebanon:** Israeli forces carried out a series of attacks across southern Lebanon on Friday, continuing near-daily violations despite the U.S.-backed ceasefire.
* An Israeli drone [carried out](https://substack.com/redirect/ec046a06-7af2-4aeb-acb5-15e7168c6c63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an airstrike on Al-Mansouri, south of Tyre (Sour) district, according to Lebanon's National News Agency.
* A Lebanese soldier was [wounded](https://substack.com/redirect/ce747f24-f4a0-49df-9588-9d0fa6a8c9e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) when an Israeli attack targeted an army bulldozer in Al-Mansouri while it was clearing roads and removing rubble, according to the Lebanese Army.
* Israeli artillery [shelled](https://substack.com/redirect/fb16ae70-2271-46cc-b942-89a8783a855c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Meiss Al-Jabal, in Marjayoun district, while Israeli forces simultaneously fired machine guns toward the town, NNA reported.
* Israeli forces [set fire](https://substack.com/redirect/e3dbe2cc-5bbb-4189-9ae4-55cb2d085ac6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Friday to the Shaqra water station in the Bint Jbeil district.
* **U.S. says Hezbollah did not violate ceasefire in Majdal Zoun:** Washington [informed](https://substack.com/redirect/a36c4a97-94ec-4502-b921-372755bb39e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Israel that Hezbollah did not violate the ceasefire in Thursday's incident in Majdal Zoun, in which an IED explosion killed two Israeli soldiers and wounded several others, an Israeli security source told Israel's public broadcaster, as reported by Al Jazeera.
* Israeli assessments also [indicate](https://substack.com/redirect/9d6b3bc1-4d52-48a6-9afc-5d78089891a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the explosive device in Majdal Zoun was planted before the ceasefire took effect, according to the broadcaster.
* The comments come as U.S. State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott [told](https://substack.com/redirect/06b93202-cfaa-45a6-b571-7907e29ebb48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Sky News Arabia the Rome talks between Lebanon and Israel were "effective and positive," saying progress was made on several technical issues.

# U.S. News
* **Trump issues more executive orders attempting to rewrite birthright citizenship law** : President Donald Trump [signed](https://substack.com/redirect/9d23537a-b247-400b-8515-8b6b2da6332b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) two executive orders Thursday seeking to deny birthright citizenship to children born to certain foreign diplomatic staff, alleged "alien enemies" including those tied to designated terrorist groups, mothers who deceptively enter the U.S. for commercial "birth tourism," and, contingent on future congressional action, people born in U.S. territories such as Puerto Rico, according to Axios.
* A second order directs the secretaries of state and homeland security to issue rules targeting the "birth tourism" industry both domestically and abroad.
* The move marks Trump's second attempt to curb birthright citizenship after the Supreme Court struck down his broader executive order on June 30.
* Legal experts expect the new orders to face 14th Amendment challenges.
* **U.S. economy shed 23,000 jobs in July:** The U.S. economy [lost](https://substack.com/redirect/88c1c1d3-e800-487b-b03e-a6dde21ae500?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a seasonally adjusted 23,000 jobs in July, according to a Bureau of Labor Statistics report released Friday.
* The figure is well below the Dow Jones consensus forecast, which had anticipated a gain of 83,000.
* The unemployment rate slipped to 4.1%, while the labor force participation fell to 61.4%, its lowest level in more than five years.
* **Trump says he 'll keep Blanche as acting AG if confirmation fails:** President Donald Trump [said](https://substack.com/redirect/7dcce5a0-4296-47d3-825c-4e9ab905fedf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) he would keep **Todd Blanche** as acting attorney general if his Senate confirmation fails, telling Punchbowl News, "We'll try it again," as Blanche's path narrowed following Alaska Sen. **Lisa Murkowski 's** decision to join Maine Sen. **Susan Collins** in opposing him. Murkowski cited the Justice Department's handling of **Jeffrey Epstein** -related files, sweeping immunity promised to Trump and his family, and statements to anti-abortion groups as reasons for her opposition, saying, "I simply do not have confidence" Blanche would check "the worst impulses of this administration."
* **ICE will only release body camera footage when in "agency's best interests":** Immigration and Customs Enforcement, which plans to equip all field officers with body cameras by the end of September, has [adopted](https://substack.com/redirect/758db888-d0df-4682-aafa-205a6053cc98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a policy that allows release of footage from shootings or serious confrontations only when the agency's director determines it is "in the best interests of the agency," according to an Associated Press investigation.
* ICE officers shot two men in Houston and Maine last month, and neither incident was recorded, despite the $20 million Congress previously allocated to ICE for body camera equipment in an April spending bill.
* ICE spent $30.9 million in July purchasing camera equipment from Axon, one day after the killing in Maine.
* **DNC autopsy author says Gaza war hurt Harris:** **Paul Rivera** , author of the Democratic National Committee's 2024 election autopsy, [confirmed](https://substack.com/redirect/d5f2e3d9-c55d-4bb4-8169-5f495b401e7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Axios that he concluded the Gaza war hurt **Kamala Harris** politically, particularly costing her votes in Michigan communities with large Arab American populations such as Dearborn.
* Rivera said he privately shared the assessment with a pro-Palestinian group, the IMEU project, but did not include it in the autopsy's final draft.
* **University of Minnesota to pay pro-Palestine professor after nixing job offer:** The University of Minnesota will [pay](https://substack.com/redirect/42dbb764-8216-4de2-9228-43208ca45549?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Israeli-American Holocaust scholar **Raz Segal** $250,000 after withdrawing an offer to lead its Center for Holocaust and Genocide Studies following backlash over his description of Israel's assault on Gaza as "a textbook case of genocide," the Guardian reported on Thursday.

# Other International News
* **Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan sign defense deal:** Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan [signed](https://substack.com/redirect/ff1c7816-4e57-4305-af8c-d1dee0318f8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a trilateral defense agreement in Saudi Arabia on Friday, aiming to "promote peace, security, and stability in the region and beyond," according to a statement announcing the deal from Pakistan's Foreign Ministry.
* The agreement "stipulates that any armed attack against any one of the three states shall be regarded as an attack against them all," according to the FM statement.
* A Turkish official told the NYT that the deal only covered mutual defense, and is "not directed against any other country."
* **U.S. intelligence claims Russia could test NATO with limited attack:** New U.S. intelligence assessments reportedly [warn](https://substack.com/redirect/5a7123d7-22d6-4b87-b7d1-1259b3501f47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Russian President Vladimir Putin could attempt to fracture NATO by launching a calibrated attack on an allied country between this fall and 2029.
* Possible scenarios in the assessments range from a cyberattack or deployment of unmarked armed groups to a limited incursion along NATO's eastern flank, with a full land assault the least likely scenario.
* The assessment comes amid increasing incidents in which Russian missiles and drones have struck or flown over NATO countries in what U.S. and European officials have described as probes of NATO's willingness to respond.
* **Bombing near Damascus wounds 14** : An explosive device planted on a minibus [wounded](https://substack.com/redirect/b2927897-0a96-4b11-975c-168f0dadfe63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 14 people Thursday night in Jaramana, a predominantly Druze suburb of Damascus, according to Syrian officials.
* Authorities initially reported two fatalities after finding what appeared to be body parts at the scene, but the Health Ministry later said they belonged to people who had been severely wounded. Some of the victims remain in serious condition, including the minibus driver.
* Authorities have not attributed responsibility for the bombing. Jaramana has experienced clashes between Druze residents and Islamist militants aligned with Syria's new authorities since the 2024 overthrow of Bashar al-Assad.
* **Former Guerrero governor arrested for evidence destruction in missing students case:** Angel Aguirre, a former governor of Mexico's southern Guerrero state, was [arrested](https://substack.com/redirect/85c657a6-bbd9-4c5a-af7d-f8e4e48431d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on charges of obstruction of justice and forced disappearance for allegedly ordering the destruction of evidence that could have shed light on the whereabouts of 43 students who disappeared in 2014, Mexican Attorney General Ernestina Godoy announced Thursday.
* Godoy said new testimony from two witnesses helped establish that Aguirre may have ordered the destruction of security camera footage during a meeting with senior officials the night of the students' disappearance.
* International probes have determined the students, who were on their way to a protest in Mexico City, were killed by organized crime members working with police.
* **Pakistan expands press restrictions to cover Pakistani nationals working for foreign media:** Pakistan [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/8a5f3007-2c7d-4703-a107-c2b753151f3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) new restrictions on journalists on Sunday, imposing routine movement controls on Pakistani nationals working for foreign media outlets for the first time.
* Journalists now require government permission to travel and report outside Islamabad, Lahore, and Karachi.
* The guidelines, whose motivation officials have not explained, come amid protests over recent multi-round elections in Pakistan-administered Kashmir and widening insurgencies in the country's western provinces.
* The country also ordered foreign outlets without reporting permits to immediately leave Pakistan-administered Kashmir. on Monday.
* Human Rights Watch called the curbs "an alarming step" in Pakistan's "narrowing space for press freedom."
* **Uganda 's parliament approves potential military deployment to Gaza:** Uganda's parliament [voted](https://substack.com/redirect/57a8f671-a878-4895-9fb5-c6d2741ed7e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday to approve deploying its military to the Gaza Strip if needed as part of a proposed multinational security force under President Donald Trump's ceasefire plan, Reuters reported.
* Defense Minister Kiryowa Kiwanuka told lawmakers before the vote that Trump had contacted Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni through emissaries in July seeking Kampala's participation.
* The move marks the first public acknowledgment by Uganda, which has peacekeeping contingents in Somalia, South Sudan, and the Democratic Republic of Congo, that it might join the International Stabilization Force envisioned under Trump's plan.
* **Attack on former Bangladesh cricketer Shakib Al Hasan 's home follows his appearance alongside Hasina**: A group [attacked](https://substack.com/redirect/1f8155b6-454e-4d8d-8193-dc70daee90e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and set fire to former Bangladesh cricket captain Shakib Al Hasan's ancestral home in Magura town Wednesday, hours after he joined ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's first public media event since her 2024 removal, Al Jazeera reported.
* During the virtual event, held on the second anniversary of her ouster, Hasina, who has been sentenced to death in absentia by Bangladesh's war crimes tribunal, said she would return to the country in December despite the risk of imprisonment or death.
* Shakib, a former Awami League lawmaker who has remained abroad since the uprising that toppled Hasina's government, faces multiple investigations over allegations of murder and money laundering.
* **Rubio announces new sanctions on Cuba:** Secretary of State Marco Rubio [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/28d6e22d-f119-40ba-a736-1b3200bb0253?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) new sanctions on Thursday against five Cuban companies and eight individuals, including Defense Minister Alvaro Lopez Miera and Chief of the General Staff Roberto Legra Sotolongo.
* The sanctions target firms including Tecnoimport, which the State Department says imports Russian and Chinese military equipment for Cuba's armed forces, and Union de Industria Militar, a weapons manufacturer.
* **Iraqi resistance leader urges pause to operations against Saudi Arabia:** Hadi al-Amiri, head of the Iraqi Badr Organization, part of the Popular Mobilisation Forces (PMF), urged Iraqi resistance groups on Friday to postpone retaliatory operations against Saudi Arabia in a video address carried by Iraqi media.
* He called groups to overlook "American-Saudi" aggression for the "sake of Iraq's highest interest."
* The U.S. and Saudi Arabia attacked the PMF headquarters in Iraq on July 29, killing more than 20 people and wounding at least 30 others.
* **Pro-Palestine protester acquitted in UK court:** Paula Akpan, one of the 10 British pro-Palestine protesters charged with criminal damage for spraying red paint across the entrances of Scotiabank in June 2024, was found not guilty in court on Thursday.
* At the time of the protest, the bank was the largest foreign shareholder in Elbit Systems, holding a $500 million stake in Israel's leading weapons manufacturer, whose military hardware has been used to kill and injure Palestinian civilians.
* Seven of Akpan's codefendants have been acquitted.
